description: Prepares cancelling one order: returns the summary to show the customer and a confirmation_token. Nothing is cancelled until confirm is called with it after the customer agrees. Only an unpaid order that is not in production can be cancelled, as on the order page; otherwise it says so. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

order.description: The order number (or the order id from its link).

name: cancel_order

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before confirming.

title: Cancel an order (asks first)
